messages:
mira (devex): quick bug/UX note — sample-app ignored env project when CLI flag was present but empty. caused us to fall back to org-only token and create subtle permission errors. repro below.
ben (sdk): oof. is this the JS SDK only or across languages?
mira (devex): repro'd in js + python. go hasn't been tested yet. steps: start with REDWOOD_PROJECT set, then run `redwood run --project ''` and SDK treated flag as higher precedence even though empty.
sam (eng): ah that matches our precedence logic: flag > env > config file. we never handled empty-string flags as "unset".
lia (security): security concern: if CLI silently ignores project and uses org scope, users may get broader access than intended. we should warn loudly and maybe block if flag explicitly passed empty.
ben (sdk): agree. proposal: treat empty-string flags as unset, preserve existing precedence otherwise. add a single-line warning when both --project and REDWOOD_PROJECT are present and values differ or when --project is empty.
kevin (docs): can we standardize names? suggestion: REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_ORG, REDWOOD_PROJECT. Also add example priority table in CLI auth docs.
cli-bot: deployment-checker running quick check on the JS/Python SDKs for flag-empty behavior...
sam (eng): small patch idea: change CLI parsing to convert "" into undefined for project/org, and update SDK auth provider to expose a function `resolveScope({flag, env, config, metadata})` so all languages can reuse logic.
ben (sdk): that sounds good. I'll draft a tiny provider API:
```
// resolve order: flag (unless empty) -> env -> config -> metadata
function resolveScope(flag, envVar, configVal, meta) {
  if (flag && flag.trim() !== '') return flag;
  if (envVar) return envVar;
  if (configVal) return configVal;
  return meta;
}
```
lia (security): also add a telemetry event and a deprecation warning if we plan to change behavior later. for rotation, we should ensure the key rotation docs show how to rotate without breaking project scoping.
kevin (docs): I'll add a sample .env snippet and a CLI example plus a small note about rotation safety. .env example: 
```
# .env
REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_live_...\nREDWOOD_ORG=acme-corp\nREDWOOD_PROJECT=payments-svc
```
mira (devex): testing plan: unit tests for resolveScope + e2e sample-app test that simulates `--project \"\"` and `--project missing` cases. then canary release to dev environment for both SDKs.
ben (sdk): I'll open SDK PRs for js/python today. tagging @kevin for docs and @lia for security review.
kevin (docs): noted. will add a small UX note: "If you pass an explicit empty flag, CLI will treat it as unset. Prefer explicit `--project your-project` or omit to use env/config."
lia (security): if we decide to block empty flags, pls call that out. I'm leaning warn+fail for server-side admin actions.
mira (devex): consensus seems to be: treat empty flags as unset, add explicit warning log, fail for admin-level ops, add provider API for parity, and update docs + tests. thanks all, please drop PR links here when ready :thumbsup:
